raw:
“I remember my first crop of strawberries on the balcony. I’d go out and look at them, and when there were actual strawberries, I felt so pleased. It’s funny, because you know what you’re hoping to grow, but seeing it there is different. I kept wanting to have another look.

At the aquarium shop, I work as a supply clerk, so I’m used to keeping track of things, what’s there and what needs to come in. But these were something I’d grown myself. And on a balcony, too—you think of a garden when you think of growing fruit. That was part of what made me happy, having that little bit of growing space right there at home. Mostly I remember thinking, ‘I actually did it.’”
